name: cc
description: A fast cc CLI for switching between Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor Agent.

scripts.check: node --check src/cc.mjs && node --check src/pi-harness.mjs && python3 -c "import pathlib; files=list(pathlib.Path('src/harnesses').rglob('*.py'))+[pathlib.Path('tests/e2e_harness_bridges.py')]; [compile(path.read_text(), str(path), 'exec') for path in files]"
scripts.test: npm run check && node tests/settings.test.mjs && python3 -c "compile(open('tests/fake_acp.py').read(), 'tests/fake_acp.py', 'exec')" && bash tests/permission_auto_smoke.sh && bash tests/tui_smoke.sh
